tenderSchedule.title: Providing service related to Pooja rituals like polishing of Shri Chamundeshwari idol and Mantapa, supplying fruits,flowers,shawl,garland etc for falicitation ceremony and providing elephant decoration and painting services to elephants of Dasara event organized by Utsava committee of Shivamogga dasara 2026.
tenderSchedule.description: Providing service related to Pooja rituals like polishing of Shri Chamundeshwari idol and Mantapa, supplying fruits,flowers,shawl,garland etc for falicitation ceremony and providing elephant decoration and painting services to elephants of Dasara event organized by Utsava committee of Shivamogga dasara 2026.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
For detailed specification refer to attached detailed estimation.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other documents as per tender document
Firm Registered Proprietor, Partnership, Public Sector or Private limited Company registration certificate.
Minimum financial turnover with UDIN not less than the estimated cost of this tender,from the annual payments for any 1 year in last 5 years

Tenderer in his name should have provided at least one similar service in any state level dasara event, in any one of last five financial years, certificate should be signed by Executive Engineer or equivalent authority
Tenderer in his name should have turnover in last 5 financial years period i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26 with UDIN number.
